title: Bahia Worker Management Bucket B backend domain model enrichment

observed_behavior.worker_liveness: domain.Worker had WorkerStatus values online/stale/offline derived from advertisement freshness.
observed_behavior.worker_capabilities: domain.Worker persisted ML-specific capabilities via ml_capabilities JSONB, but did not expose generic capability, scheduling intent, note, or label fields.
observed_behavior.worker_repository: PgWorkerRepository read and wrote the existing worker advertisement fields through insert, conflict update, get, and list queries.

intended_behavior.scheduling_state: Workers expose operator scheduling intent separately from liveness using active, cordoned, draining, maintenance, and disabled states.
intended_behavior.labels: Workers carry JSONB-backed key/value labels suitable for selector-style querying.
intended_behavior.generic_capabilities: Workers carry a generic capability envelope while preserving existing MLCapabilities for backward compatibility.
intended_behavior.persistence: PostgreSQL worker rows persist and hydrate scheduling state, scheduling note, labels, and generic capabilities.

out_of_scope: placement enforcement in worker_policy.go or ml_placement.go
